goal: Validate Azure-MemForest quality improvements without benchmark leakage, per-case overfitting, or confounded runtime changes.

development_sets.targeted_slices: Use known failure slices only to verify a specific fix mechanism, not to claim broad parity.
development_sets.regression_10: Use for quick no-regression checks after targeted fixes.
development_sets.heldout_50: Use as a clean validation gate. Do not tune per-case against it after declaring a candidate.
development_sets.official_full_session: Run only after clean heldout_50 evidence is operationally and qualitatively acceptable.

noise_floor.interpretation: Accuracy changes smaller than or equal to this band require repeat runs or adjudication before being treated as real.
